one_liner: An interactive analysis of public AI system-prompt archives and aggregate jailbreak technique patterns without reproducing exploit text.
hook: Hundreds of public AI rulebooks, one map: compare what they emphasize, how they cluster, and where their instructions overlap.
safe_demo_scenes: Open the similarity web and move between clusters of public archived prompts.
Use the diff machine on two public prompts and show line-level structural differences.
Show Counter-spells only as aggregate technique categories, never exploit text.
verification_commands: python -m py_compile src/build_data.py src/embed.py src/jailbreaks.py src/build.py
allowed_claims: The project analyzes public prompt archives and credits their upstream sources.
Similarity uses TF-IDF features rather than neural embeddings.
The jailbreak view is aggregate and does not reproduce exploit text.
forbidden_claims: The archive is complete or authoritative for all AI systems.
The project reveals private prompts or operational jailbreak payloads.
privacy: Show only public archive content already included by the project.
Do not surface hidden/private prompt data or raw jailbreak payloads.
